how_to_verify: The probe exits 0 only when every family-expectation check in this matrix passes on the host device; the capability record is written next to the run summary.

sources.note: Family expectations are transcribed from Apple's documentation and must be re-checked against the current Feature Set Tables PDF when a check fails on new hardware. Runtime device queries, not families, are the gating authority (assumption A2).

metal_driver_arch.evidence: platform/macos/detect.py:309-311 disables metal on any other arch with a warning.

x86_64_deployment_target.evidence: platform/macos/detect.py:114-116; Intel Macs are build/Vulkan lanes only.

driver_entry_point.value: MTL3::RenderingDeviceDriverMetal (subclass of RenderingDeviceDriverMetal, where the 14 RT stubs live)

has_feature.value: SUPPORTS_RAY_QUERY reports the C11 compute-lane gate result; SUPPORTS_RAYTRACING_PIPELINE remains false until SceneShaderRaytracing is re-expressed for Metal

runtime_gates_current.rt_gating_expression: macOS arm64 && project setting enabled && GODOT_MTL_DISABLE_RAYTRACING != 1 && supportsRaytracing && supportsFunctionPointers && supports_user_id_instances && supports_gpu_address && argument_buffers_enabled() && msl_target_version >= 2.3

gpu_family_expectations.apple6: A13 Bionic. First family listing ray tracing (compute + render) and function pointers in Apple's feature tables. Baseline RT lane.
gpu_family_expectations.apple7: M1 / A14. Adds simdReduction, border colors, multisample layered rendering (engine already gates these).
gpu_family_expectations.apple8: M2 / A15-A16. 64-bit image atomics only in combination with mac2.
gpu_family_expectations.apple9: M3 / A17 Pro and later. Dedicated hardware ray-tracing acceleration; 'RT advanced' lane in the testing standard.
gpu_family_expectations.apple10_and_later: Reported by M5 hardware (raw family value 1010). Newer than the engine's family scan, which caps at apple9 (drivers/metal/metal_device_properties.cpp:110); superset of apple9 for RT purposes.
gpu_family_expectations.mac2: Intel-era Mac family. Some AMD GPUs report supportsRaytracing, but the engine never builds the Metal driver for x86_64, so mac2-only devices are out of scope (assumption A1).

capabilities.description: Encode BLAS/TLAS builds, refits, and copies on the GPU timeline.
AS compaction to reclaim memory after builds.

Trace rays from compute kernels (metal::raytracing::intersector / intersection_query, MSL 2.3+). This is the execution model for command_trace_rays; Metal has no standalone ray-tracing pipeline object.
Visible function tables from compute pipelines; the substrate for emulating Vulkan shader groups / SBT records.
Custom intersection functions for procedural (bounding-box) geometry, needed by RTProceduralInstance3D-style scenes. Triangle-only scenes can ship without it.
Ray tracing from vertex/fragment/tile stages. Not needed for the compute-based first scope (assumption A5).
Visible function tables from render pipelines. Only relevant if rt_from_render is ever used.
Keyframed primitive motion in acceleration structures. The fork's path tracer does not use motion blur.

GPU-driven instance descriptors referencing BLASes by MTLResourceID instead of descriptor-array index; enables writing TLAS instances from the GPU. The macOS 11 path (instancedAccelerationStructures array) works without it.
Raw GPU virtual addresses for buffers; used by the Metal backend's bindless plumbing and likely by RT mesh/material access (audit in C7).

Tier-2 argument buffers usable without MTLArgumentEncoder. The engine only clears needs_arg_encoders on macOS 13+ with the Metal3 family, so the bindless path the path tracer depends on effectively requires macOS 13 (assumption A4).
capabilities.expected_min_family: apple6 (tier2); metal3 family for encoder-free path

capabilities.description: MTLResidencySet for bulk residency of bindless/RT resources; replaces per-encoder useResource calls.
64-bit image atomics; audit in C7 whether the path tracer's accumulation targets need them.
Dedicated ray-tracing hardware. No direct API query exists; the apple9 family bit is the proxy. Performance tiering only - correctness must not depend on it.
Unified memory; informs storage-mode choices for scratch, instance, and readback buffers (assumption A8).
MSL 2.3 is the first shading-language version with ray-tracing intrinsics; the engine's minimum supported MSL is already 2.3 and the target version is device-derived.

driver_method_requirements._note: The 14 stub methods from docs/rt_metal_port/baseline.md section 3, mapped to the capability ids above.
raytracing_pipeline_get_shader_group_han: function_pointers_compute (handles become function-table indices, assumption A6)

verified_devices.families: apple1-apple10, mac2, common1-3, metal3, metal4 all true; apple11+ false
verified_devices.raytracing: supportsRaytracing, supportsRaytracingFromRender, supportsFunctionPointers, supportsFunctionPointersFromRender, supportsPrimitiveMotionBlur all true
verified_devices.lane_coverage: Covers 'RT baseline' (apple6+) and 'RT advanced' (apple9+) lanes from the testing standard. No apple7 (M1) or apple8 (M2) coverage yet.
